# 🚀 OPEN MAINTENANCE PULL REQUEST

<a name="top"></a>

**Open Maintenance Pull Request, called with `uses:` at the step level.**

_One `uses:` line, one job done._

</div>

---

## 💡 What This Folder Is For

[`action.yml`](action.yml) is the `open-pr` composite action: commits working-tree changes to a fixed branch and opens or updates one evolving pull request. Another repository calls it as `tannergolden/standards/.github/actions/open-pr@v1`, and this repository's own self-checks as `./.github/actions/open-pr`. It ships [`.github/scripts/open-pr.sh`](../../scripts/open-pr.sh), found beside it at `$GITHUB_ACTION_PATH`. Its inputs and outputs are documented in `action.yml` itself.
